title: Tortured Soul in Gallery
description: A large surreal painting hangs on a decaying gallery wall, depicting a gaunt, emaciated figure with exposed ribs screaming in agony, blood dripping from its hands and chest. The surrounding room features a lit candelabra, scattered torn papers and cards on the wooden floor, and multiple smaller eerie paintings with melting faces and ghostly figures on the walls.
prompt: dark surreal horror scene inside an old decaying art gallery, large central painting shows a screaming emaciated humanoid figure with exposed ribs, bleeding wounds and hands, surrounded by swirling ghostly faces and abstract forms, multiple smaller grotesque paintings with melting faces hang on the walls, lit candelabra on the floor casting dramatic light, torn papers and bloody cards scattered across wooden floor, paint visibly dripping down the walls, eerie and oppressive atmosphere
